items.heading: Most "Benefits of Counselling" Lists
items.text: Most "benefits of counselling" lists online cite each other, not a study. Here is what independent, peer-reviewed research has actually measured, so the claim can be checked rather than taken on faith.

items.heading: Most Indian Students Can Name
items.text: Most Indian students can name ten careers or fewer out of more than 250 that realistically exist. The first, most measurable benefit is simply widening that list before you narrow it.

items.heading: A Page Built on Honest
items.text: A page built on honest evidence has to name the limits too, or it is not a fair comparison.

items.heading: A Test Alone Can Narrow
items.text: A test alone can narrow a long list quickly and cheaply. It cannot cross-check that shortlist against your family's financial reality or revisit the plan as circumstances change, that is what a counsellor adds.

items.heading: If the Decision Is Expensive,
items.text: If the decision is expensive, hard to reverse, or you are still stuck after reading enough, the research shows structured counselling makes a measurable difference over guessing alone.

items.heading: A Wider, More Accurate Map
items.text: A wider, more accurate map of real options instead of the handful you already knew.
